_readme: Editorial picks for the film. select-cars.mjs merges these with the live public API (read-only) and writes cars.json. 'photos' are indexes into the listing's image array, best first. A car that is no longer live, or whose chosen photos fall below the size floor, is dropped automatically and reported.

cars.note: Listing make/model fields say 'Nissan Crossover SUV'; title and photos are a Denza N7. The film uses the listing title, which is what the app and website display.
Listing fuel says Petrol; the standout detail shown is mileage, not fuel.
